descriptions.CLEAN: No error: every check should pass
descriptions.AMOUNT: One JE line's amount differs from the invoice
descriptions.VENDOR: The JE names another vendor than the invoice
descriptions.REFERENCE: The JE's invoice reference differs from the invoice number
descriptions.DATE: The invoice is dated months before the JE period
descriptions.APPROVAL_SHORT: The approved amount is below the JE total
descriptions.CURRENCY: The invoice is in another currency than the JE
descriptions.UNSUPPORTED_LINE: The JE has a line no document supports
